grammar.summary: 本课以「巧合促成兄弟团聚」为线索，集中运用了定语从句、过去完成时与分词短语作状语，并出现 was thought to have been 表示对过去的推断。重点体会叙事中如何用定语从句交代人物背景、用过去完成时理清事件先后、用分词表现伴随动作。

points.title: 定语从句 (Relative Clauses)
points.explanation: 用关系代词 who/which/that 引导定语从句，who 指人。本课用 who was thought to have been killed 修饰兄弟，用 which anyone but... would find incredible 修饰巧合，补充人物背景。

examples.en: When I was a boy, my grandfather told me how a German taxi driver, Franz Bussman, found a brother who was thought to have been killed twenty years before.
examples.cn: 当我是个孩子的时候，我祖父给我讲了一位德国出租汽车司机弗朗兹·巴斯曼如何找到了据信已在20年前死去的兄弟的事。

examples.en: A long-lost brother, who was presumed dead, was really alive all the time and wickedly plotting to bring about the hero's downfall.
examples.cn: 主人公一位长期失散的兄弟，大家都以为死了，实际上一直活着，并且正在策划暗算主人公。

examples.en: Yet, in real life, circumstances do sometimes conspire to bring about coincidences which anyone but a nineteenth century novelist would find incredible.
examples.cn: 不过，在现实生活中，有时确实会出现一些巧合，这些巧合除了19世纪小说家外谁也不会相信。

points.title: 过去完成时 (Past Perfect)
points.explanation: 过去完成时 (had + 过去分词) 表示「先于过去某动作发生」的动作。本课中「被送进医院」先于「与部队失散」，「家被炸毁」先于「返回故里」，故用 had been sent / had been bombed，理清事件先后。

examples.en: After having been wounded towards the end of the war, he had been sent to hospital and was separated from his unit.
examples.cn: 战争即将结束时，他负伤被送进医院，并与部队失去联系。

examples.en: Hans returned to his family home, but the house had been bombed and no one in the neighbourhood knew what had become of the inhabitants.
examples.cn: 汉斯重返故里，但他的家已被炸毁，左邻右舍谁也不知原住户的下落。

points.title: 分词短语作状语 (Participle Phrases as Adverbials)
points.explanation: 现在分词 (v-ing) 作状语表主动伴随，过去分词/完成式分词表先于主句的动作。本课用 pointing out 表伴随，用 After having been wounded 表先发生，使叙述紧凑。

examples.en: Franz poured scorn on the idea, pointing out that his brother had been killed in action during the war.
examples.cn: 弗朗兹对此不屑一顾，指出他兄弟已经在战争中阵亡了。

examples.en: After having been wounded towards the end of the war, he had been sent to hospital and was separated from his unit.
examples.cn: 战争即将结束时，他负伤被送进医院，并与部队失去联系。

examples.en: Assuming that his family had been killed during an air raid, Hans settled down in a village fifty miles away where he had remained ever since.
examples.cn: 汉斯以为全家人都在空袭中遇难，于是便在距此50英里外的一座村子里定居下来，直至当日。

exercises.q: When I was a boy, my grandfather told me how a German taxi driver, Franz Bussman, found a brother ______ was thought to have been killed twenty years before.
Hans returned to his family home, but the house ______ bombed and no one in the neighbourhood knew what had become of the inhabitants.
Franz poured scorn on the idea, ______ out that his brother had been killed in action during the war.
下列哪个词与课文中 conspire 的含义最接近？
用分词填空：______ (assume) that his family had been killed during an air raid, Hans settled down in a village fifty miles away where he had remained ever since.（写出 assume 的正确形式）
